notes.title: Steam Deck & Linux Support is now live!
notes.content:
NEW
Linux Support

Steam Deck Support


General Updates
Best Score: Added a best score counter for the top score achieved during the session.

Score Display: Large scores now display with comma formatting for better readability (e.g., 1,234,567).

Game Over Delay: Added 2-second delay before allowing restart to prevent accidental restarts.

Controller Support: Improved gamepad device support.

YYC Compiler: Switched from VM to YYC compiler for improved performance across all platforms.


Bug Fixes
Fixed Steam Achievement Bug: "First Time Player" achievement now properly unlocks on first game launch.


Steam Deck Optimisations
Native 1280x800 fullscreen support.

Proper text scaling for 7" display readability.



The patch notes can also be read on the 5 Years Now website.
